desc:
NEW: CARE MODE + PET BUGS!

Swat, stomp and spray your way through a pixel world full of bugs. Or drop a fat toad in and watch it gulp them down.

Squish them all... or catch them with a cup and set them free. Your call.

💚 CARE MODE: catch bugs, set them free, earn Keeper titles
🏡 Adopt up to 4 pet bugs, name them and watch them grow
🪴 Decorate their terrarium: 55 decorations, 9 themes, cute hats
🐝 Visitor bugs drop by to play and leave gifts

CODES: BUGS, CREEPYCRAWLY (enter them in the SHOP)

🐞 22 bugs: roaches, ants, ladybugs, bees, mantises and more
🧰 120 tools: swatters, slippers, giant boots and bug spray
🌩️ 91 powers: thunderstorms, frog rain, killer hornets and more
🗺️ 17 rooms, from a picnic to the moon
🐚 112 shells to dress your bugs in
👥 Play with friends in your room
📖 Fill your BUG-DEX and climb the boards

Right click: swat (hold to spray) · Left click: grab
1-0 / Q E: pick a tool · Space: freeze · G: slow-mo
Z: undo · P: photo · F1: every key
